description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Cincinnati Tri-State (OH-KY-IN) market (PTF-CINCINNATI-RELEASE-CONTRACT-001). Every number below is derived from this market's own committed authority via scripts.pettripfinder.release_contracts.derive_authority, not hard-coded from memory. It describes only this market's reviewed authority and grants no deployment authorization.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is structurally deployable: its authority files agree, its routes match its reviewed inventory, no held identity leaks, and every publish/tech gate holds. It is NOT a deployment authorization and makes no claim that the market's identity universe is fully resolved -- 160 of this market's 256 confirmed identities are still unresolved.

identity_census.note: The committed census is the Cincinnati Tri-State identity universe (OH/KY/IN). 74 founder-approved pet-friendly profiles and 16 verified-no-pets exclusions are published; 6 identities are ruled out of the current lodging category; 160 remain unresolved.

reconciliation.note: Counts are derived from the committed policy package and exclusion registry via derive_authority(); unresolved is not negative pet evidence. 256 = 99 + 47 + 6 + 104.

policy_package.note: The live Cincinnati policy package is the sole identity authority for its 99 verified profiles. 21 were written by the Capture Pass 1 applications; APPLICATION-004 added 53; FREE-LANE-APPLICATION-007 added 17 from the zero-cost attended-Chrome brand lane; PTF-CINCINNATI-FREE-LANE-APPLICATION-010 added 8 from the zero-cost independent probes (PROBE-008 and PROBE-009) -- one clean candidate plus four Drury properties and three partial approvals the founder ruled individually. No hard-coded allow-list is repeated here.
policy_package.schema_note: Schema 1.3. PTF-CINCINNATI-HARDENED-SYNC-002 stamped the package from 1.2 to 1.3 -- an additive amendment (enums.CANONICAL_POLICY_SCHEMA_VERSIONS holds both) that added the service_animal_statement.quote field the founder's Capture Pass 1 statements had nowhere to live in. Seven records gained that quote; no fact, evidence entry, withholding or founder decision changed. record_hash is taken over the whole record, so stamping the version moved it on all twenty-one: each approval carries a 'rebinding' block naming the prior hash and what moved, evidence_hash is unchanged throughout, and no decision was re-asked or re-signed.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every other unresolved or category-excluded census identity has no seed row and no public route. This market currently holds none -- every seed row it owns is published.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor, and policy-comparison pages live under /pet-friendly-hotels/cincinnati-oh/. 14 of this market's 22 configured corridors are above their publication minimum and claim a route, derived from the 99 published hotels' own corridor assignments; the market is registered assemblable but not yet enabled in primary navigation (show_in_navigation is a separate, unrelated market-config setting).

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
